about.title: Hi! I'm Maria Fernanda Melo e Reis.
about.text1: I'm 18, I live in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, and I study Software Engineering at PUC Minas. I'm currently an IT intern at ITShare, working on automation and AI-assisted development.

aurora.name: Aurora
aurora.description: A mobile mental health app that connects patients and psychologists. Patients log how they feel day to day, and psychologists follow those entries between sessions. The app also includes a blog with content from the professionals.
aurora.imageAlt: Login screen of the Aurora app

sintoniza.name: Sintoniza
sintoniza.description: A web platform that connects venues and independent music artists. Artists create profiles with their style and portfolio, and venues search and filter options to find the right artist.
sintoniza.imageAlt: Sintoniza home screen with the venue search
